necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). Due to the intermittent nature of these symptoms, long-term continuous ECG monitoring via CPT 93247 is clinically indicated to correlate clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances. This service is necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse as documented in the clinical indication note.
